Chapter 3 - ColorSync Manager Reference for Applications and Device Drivers / Constants and Data Types
Color Values

CMY Color Value

A color value expressed in the CMY color space is composed of cyan, magenta, and yellow component values. Each color component is expressed as a numeric value within the range of 0 to 65535 inclusive. 
struct CMCMYColor {
   unsigned shortcyan;  
   unsigned shortmagenta;
   unsigned shortyellow;
};
